study type: Retrospective case-control study combined with in vitro experiments
cohort: The study included placental tissues from 30 puerperae with preeclampsia and 30 healthy puerperae, all of whom delivered by cesarean section, along with BeWo trophoblast cells for in vitro experiments.
finding: The expression of TFDP2 was significantly decreased in the placentas of patients with preeclampsia, which may promote the apoptosis of syncytiotrophoblasts by inhibiting the PKAc/beta-catenin signaling pathway.
